title: Solar Terminator
subtitle: The moving line dividing Earth's daylight illumination and nocturnal darkness, computed from high-precision orbital astronomy.

seasonPresets.name: Vernal Equinox
seasonPresets.description: Sun shines perpendicularly over the equator. Day and night are nearly equal worldwide (~12h).

seasonPresets.name: Summer Solstice
seasonPresets.description: Sun is at zenith over Tropic of Cancer. Arctic experiences midnight sun; Antarctica is in total darkness.

seasonPresets.name: Autumnal Equinox
seasonPresets.description: Subsolar point crosses equator southward. Global day and night lengths balance again.

seasonPresets.name: Winter Solstice
seasonPresets.description: Sun is at zenith over Tropic of Capricorn. Antarctic experiences perpetual daylight; Arctic polar night.
